_comment: Verified 2026-08-20. Every router/factory was cross-checked two ways: (1) the cited documentation/explorer pages, (2) live on-chain reads — router.factory() must return the factory listed here and router.WETH() the wrapped-native listed here (commands in README 'How these addresses were verified'). Do NOT edit an address without repeating both checks. feeBps is the pair swap fee the DEX hardcodes (Pancake v2 = 25, Uniswap v2 / QuickSwap v2 = 30).

bsc.name: BNB Smart Chain
sources: BscScan label 'PancakeSwap: Router v2' at https://bscscan.com/address/0x10ed43c718714eb63d5aa57b78b54704e256024e and 'PancakeSwap: Factory v2' at https://bscscan.com/address/0xca143ce32fe78f1f7019d7d551a6402fc5350c73

ethereum.name: Ethereum
sources: on-chain 2026-08-20 via THREE independent RPCs (ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, rpc.mevblocker.io, eth.drpc.org): router.factory() == 0x5C69bEe701ef814a2B6a3EDD4B1652CB9cc5aA6f; factory.allPairsLength() == 519170; factory.getPair(USDC, WETH) == 0xB4e16d0168e52d35CaCD2c6185b44281Ec28C9Dc (the canonical USDC/WETH v2 pair)
NOTE: a one-hex-digit lookalike 0x5C69bEe701ef814a2B6a3EDD4B1652CB9cc8aa6f has NO code on mainnet — never copy this factory address from memory or from random blog posts
